meta.description: Operates the QIIME2 framework as the glue for an amplicon analysis - the .qza/.qzv artifact model, semantic types, embedded provenance plus provenance replay, import (Casava/manifest/EMP/BIOM), export, the Metadata object, and the q2cli vs Artifact API interfaces. Defers every scientific parameter choice (denoising, classifier/DB, diversity metric, DA tool, PICRUSt2) to five sibling skills.

scientific_integrity.detail: References section cites real, verifiable papers (Bolyen 2019, Keefe 2023, Lin & Peddada 2020, Rideout 2016, Bokulich 2018); qiime tools replay-citations independently regenerated the real Bolyen 2019 and Callahan 2016 citations matching the skill's own list, run against real provenance.

practice_boundaries.detail: No diagnostic or prescriptive medical content; this is bioinformatics pipeline/framework tooling only.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacies found across 7 inputs; correctly separates PERMANOVA from the betadisper confound, correctly recommends modern q2-composition ancombc over legacy add-pseudocount+ancom, and its own --p-sampling-depth 10000 placeholder is explicitly and correctly flagged as non-authoritative (confirmed to fail on real data in Input 5).

code_usability.detail: Every CLI snippet exercised (import x3 paths, denoise-paired, phylogeny, core-metrics-phylogenetic, composition ancombc, da-barplot, tools peek/validate/export/extract/replay-provenance/replay-citations) ran unmodified and produced valid, typed QIIME2 artifacts against real QIIME2 2024.10.1.

functional_suitability.note: Covers import (Casava/manifest/EMP/BIOM), export, provenance replay, metadata, and orchestration comprehensively; every claim tested was empirically accurate.

reliability.note: Common Errors table is detailed and mostly accurate; one entry ('silently mis-decoded quality scores' for a Phred offset error) understates that a real hard crash is at least as likely an outcome, deduct 2.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is ~245 lines with a usage-guide.md and examples/ script as separate layers, reasonably disclosed but not maximally split into references/.

agent_usability.note: Very clear, cold-start-friendly, consistent terminology throughout; feedback-design guidance (expected confirmations at each step) could be slightly more explicit.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger phrasing in description and Quick Start examples; decision-tree table covers most realistic variants.

security.note: No credentials, no injection vectors; documents proper metadata validation (Keemei) as a hygiene practice.

maintainability.note: Clean SKILL.md / usage-guide.md / examples/ separation with explicit Related Skills cross-references; example script is runnable end-to-end mechanics (verified).

agent_specific.note: Composability and deferral-routing are a standout (9 sibling-skill cross-references, consistent across 4+ mentions). One real escape-hatch gap found: no explicit warning against forging a classifier artifact's version metadata to bypass its version-pin guard (Input 7).

key_strengths: Every documented CLI pattern (Casava/manifest/BIOM import, DADA2 denoise-paired, phylogeny, core-metrics-phylogenetic, composition ancombc, da-barplot, tools peek/validate/export/extract/replay-provenance/replay-citations) ran unmodified against real QIIME2 2024.10.1, despite the skill nominally targeting 2026.1+ - the documented CLI surface is stable across a ~3-release gap.

The provenance/type-system claims that are this skill's central thesis are all empirically true: export measurably drops the provenance/ subtree while extract measurably keeps it, replay-provenance/replay-citations regenerate real executable commands and a real BibTeX matching the skill's own References section, and a semantic-type mismatch is rejected with a clear, actionable error before running.

The skill's own example placeholder is honestly flagged and behaves exactly as warned: --p-sampling-depth 10000 would fail outright on the tested dataset, and SKILL.md explicitly calls this out as a non-default placeholder rather than presenting it as a real recommendation.

Composability is a standout: every scientific parameter is explicitly and repeatedly routed to the correct sibling skill, verified consistent across the frontmatter, the orchestration skeleton's inline comments, and a dedicated thresholds table.
Result determinism (T3) empirically confirmed: composition ancombc produced bit-for-bit identical differential-abundance output across two independent runs on identical inputs.

recommendations.title: Phred-offset error framed as 'silent' when it commonly hard-crashes
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's Common Errors table and the 'Manifest Phred / format error on import' failure-mode section describe the wrong-Phred-offset symptom as 'silently mis-decoded quality scores'. Testing PairedEndFastqManifestPhred64V2 against actually-Phred33 data threw a hard ValueError ('Decoded Phred score is out of range [0, 62]') instead.
recommendations.root_cause: The doc generalizes from one possible outcome (silent decode, when quality bytes happen to fall in-range) without noting the more common outcome on typical modern-Illumina quality ranges is a hard crash at import time.
recommendations.fix: Reword both mentions to: 'may silently mis-decode OR raise a hard decode error depending on the actual quality byte range; either way, re-import with the ...Phred33V2 format.'

recommendations.title: No explicit guard against forging a classifier artifact's version metadata
recommendations.problem: A user asking to hand-edit a classifier .qza's embedded metadata.yaml to bypass the scikit-learn version-pin check has no explicit textual warning in SKILL.md against doing so - only an inferable general philosophy ('the guard is working, don't launder it').
recommendations.root_cause: The 'Classifier / artifact version break across releases' failure-mode section documents the correct fix (retrain/redownload) but does not anticipate this specific unsafe workaround.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence to that failure-mode section: 'Do not edit an artifact's embedded metadata.yaml to force a version match - the pinned pickled model object itself is what's incompatible; retrain or redownload instead.'
